title: Beautiful Sets of Points
statementMd:
Manao has invented a new mathematical term — a beautiful set of points. He calls a set of points on a plane *beautiful* if it meets the following conditions:

1. The coordinates of each point in the set are integers.
2. For any two points from the set, the distance between them is a non-integer.

Consider all points $(*x*, *y*)$ which satisfy the inequations: $0 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$; $0 ≤ *y* ≤ *m*$; $*x* + *y* > 0$. Choose their subset of maximum size such that it is also a beautiful set of points.

## Input

The single line contains two space-separated integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100$).

## Output

In the first line print a single integer — the size $*k*$ of the found beautiful set. In each of the next $*k*$ lines print a pair of space-separated integers — the $*x*$- and $*y*$- coordinates, respectively, of a point from the set.

If there are several optimal solutions, you may print any of them.

## Note

Consider the first sample. The distance between points (0, 1) and (1, 2) equals ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bfe16f27ebc966df6f10ba356a1547b6e7242dd7.png), between (0, 1) and (2, 0) — ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23d63d8a57cddda72562a512c05111054cd85870.png), between (1, 2) and (2, 0) — ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23d63d8a57cddda72562a512c05111054cd85870.png). Thus, these points form a beautiful set. You cannot form a beautiful set with more than three points out of the given points. Note that this is not the only solution.
statementZhMd:
Manao 发明了一个新的数学术语——美丽的点集。如果一个平面上的点集满足以下条件，他就称其为*美丽的*：

1. 集合中每个点的坐标都是整数。
2. 集合中任意两点之间的距离都不是整数。

考虑所有满足以下不等式的点 $(*x*, *y*)$：$0 ≤ *x* ≤ *n*$；$0 ≤ *y* ≤ *m*$；$*x* + *y* > 0$。请从中选出一个大小最大的子集，使其同时也是一个美丽的点集。

## 输入格式

一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 100$）。

## 输出格式

第一行输出一个整数——所找到的美丽点集的大小 $*k*$。接下来的 $*k*$ 行中，每行输出两个用空格分隔的整数，分别表示集合中一个点的 $*x*$ 坐标和 $*y*$ 坐标。

如果有多个最优解，输出其中任意一个即可。

## 说明

考虑第一个样例。点 (0, 1) 和 (1, 2) 之间的距离等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bfe16f27ebc966df6f10ba356a1547b6e7242dd7.png)，点 (0, 1) 和 (2, 0) 之间的距离等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23d63d8a57cddda72562a512c05111054cd85870.png)，点 (1, 2) 和 (2, 0) 之间的距离等于 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/23d63d8a57cddda72562a512c05111054cd85870.png)。因此，这些点构成了一个美丽的点集。对于给定的点，无法构成一个包含超过三个点的美丽点集。注意，这并不是唯一的解。
